Walk to an old mine entrance and a restored battery - there are other relics from gold mining days as well so plenty to keep kids entertained. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 15 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.
Christchurch to Little River Rail Trail

The whole 46 km-long walkway and cycleway runs from Hornby in Christchurch to Little River on Banks Peninsula. The Motukārara to Little River section described here covers 20 km. This walking track is graded easy. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Walk through bush and along the beach to explore the impressive Cathedral Caves. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 30 min one way. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.
Walk through a nikau grove and podocarp/broadleaf forest. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 30 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.
Cape Reinga/Te Rerenga Wairua Lighthouse Walk

Enjoy outstanding panoramic views and pay respect to a site steeped in Māori tradition on a short stroll to an iconic lighthouse – it's suitable for children and buggies. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 10 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

A seal colony, a lighthouse and panoramic views of mountains and coastline feature on this spectacular coastal walkway. With the beach close by as well it's a good option for children. It's also one of our best short walks. This walking track is graded easiest to easy. Published walking time: 1 hr 15 min one way. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

A short climb with rewarding views of the glacier, mountains and river flats. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 1 hr - 1 hr 40. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Follow the Callery Gorge Walk as it climbs to a high terrace before descending to the Callery River. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 1 hr 20 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Enjoy the coastal views on this walkway between Rotokura/Cable Bay and The Glen, near Nelson. Boating, sea kayaking, and snorkeling are all possible. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 3 hr 30 min one way. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Spot New Zealand fur seals/kekeno and yellow-eyed penguins/hoiho from this cliff-top walk. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 10 - 20 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Ngarunui Track is a short walk starting from Bryant Memorial Reserve. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 20 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Explore the fascinating and family-friendly historic Brunner Mine and enjoy the interactive displays. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 1 hr. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

An easy walk through a podocarp and broadleaf forest remnant with impressive specimens of rimu, totara and kahikatea. It's a great walk for kids. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 1 hr loop. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Walk to an abandoned bridge in the heart of the Whanganui National Park. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 1 hr 30 min return. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

This easy loop track in Fiordland forest in Monowai is suitable for families. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 40 min return. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.
Bob’s Cove Track and Nature Walk

This short walk passes through native bush to reach a stunning cove on Lake Wakatipu, with an optional climb to Picnic Point – it's a great option for kids. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 20 min to Bobs Cove, 30 min to Picnic Point. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Nestled among mature beech and podocarp forest, these pools of deep, clear water flowing into the Makarora River offer a moment of tranquillity. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 1 hr return. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Enjoy native bush and quiet beaches. The track provides good opportunities to look out over the Blue Lake (Tikitapu) and Green Lake (Rotokakahi). This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 1 hr 30 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

This short walking track winds through forest to some of Southland’s largest and oldest tōtara trees in a forest that has never been logged. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 30 min return. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

This walking and mountain biking track passes through native and pine forest from Penzance Bay to Elaine Bay. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 3 hr 30 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Several times a day the gates at the Aratiatia dam are opened to release the full flow of the river - a spectacular sight from the lookout points. Stay safe and keep clear of the rapids at all times. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 10 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

The Aramoana Boardwalk and saltmarsh experience, and other short walks from Aramoana on the edge of Otago Harbour, suit all ages and abilities. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 20 to 45 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Aorere Goldfields Track is a 3-hour loop, which gives you access to explore some of the more accessible gold-mining remnants. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 3 hr loop. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

This track passes through coastal forest, pine-clad valleys and dense native bush - with a fairly easy grade it's suitable for children, although some climbing is required and there are a few steep places. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 2 hr. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

The Alpine Nature Walk in Lewis Pass provides an opportunity to break up a long drive while enjoying spectacular scenery and beech forest. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 20 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

Walk 5 minutes from the carpark to Allans Beach and see sea lions. This walking track is graded easiest. Published walking time: 5 min. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.
Alice Nash Memorial Heritage Lodge Track

This track in the scenic Oroua River valley can be enjoyed as a half day tramp but it's also a good overnight tramp for families with children and new trampers. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 30 min one way. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.

The track starts from Opito Bay and splits into a series of short, easy walks - visit a small beach in the Te Puna Inlet and a pa site on Tareha Point. This walking track is graded easy. Published walking time: 15-30 min one way. Check the DOC route guide for the starting point and current alerts.
